name: Choking Black
description: Pour a thick black into the lungs of a foe through his own breath until his strength fails.

name: Gloom Lance
description: Hurl a long lance of packed gloom that pierces a thrown shield and stings the arm behind it.

name: Obscuring Pall
description: Let a pall spread outward from the user until sight and sound both fail within its reach.

name: Sable Ward
description: Set a thick sable ward before the body that drinks the force out of a heavy blow.

name: Abyssal Mantle
description: Wrap the whole body in a mantle of deep dark that swallows blows and the sight of the wearer.

name: Strangling Gloom
description: Wind gloom round the limbs and throat of a foe and draw it tight until he cannot move.

name: Umbral Torrent
description: Pour a roaring torrent of umbra over a wide ground and batter all who stand in it.

name: Dread Weight
description: Lay the full dread of the dark on a group of foes until their knees give way.

name: Lightless Rift
description: Open a rift of lightless dark through the qi field and step out of it at a chosen point.

name: Unbarred Verdict
description: Pass a verdict of hollow dark through a foe's defences that no guard or shield can bar.

name: Silent Plunge
description: Plunge into the dark at one edge of the field and surface at the other without a sound.

name: Black Decree
description: Speak the decree of dark and strike so the foe is held and broken in the same moment.

name: Falling Eclipse
description: Draw an eclipse down over the whole field to the destructive limit of the caster's tier and crush all beneath it.

name: Unreturning Tide
description: Loose a tide of dark that rolls to the full reach of the tier and leaves nothing lit or standing in it.

name: Shrouded Edge
description: Cut from within a shroud so the edge of the hand is seen only as it lands.

name: Dread Cloak
description: Wear a cloak of dread that steadies the user and chills every foe who meets the eye.

name: Creeping Black
description: Let a slow black creep along the ground and up the legs of the foes until they stall.

name: Mute Dark
description: Stop all sound in a ring of ground so that calls and chants die before they leave the throat.

name: Ebon Mantle
description: Hold a mantle of ebon dark drawn from the core that stands against the heaviest blows.

name: Stifling Burden
description: Press the whole weight of the dark on one foe until he cannot breathe or lift a hand.

name: Gloam Surge
description: Surge a heavy wall of gloam over the ground and throw all in its path to the earth.

name: Blinding Reign
description: Cast a rule of blindness over the field so that foes see nothing but the dark the user wills.

name: Abyss Step
description: Drop through the dark into a deep place and rise at the other end of the field.

name: Lightkill
description: Strike at the light in a foe's body and put it out past any guard he can raise.

name: Pitch Sealing
description: Pour pitch-black dark over a foe's qi and seal every channel of it shut.

name: Black Crown
description: Set a crown of black on a foe's head and bring the whole weight of the core down on it.

name: Eclipse Throne
description: Sit enthroned in an eclipse of the core that holds foes down and guards the seat from all blows.

name: Final Eclipse
description: Bring the full dark of the core down as one eclipse to the destructive ceiling of the caster's tier.

name: Lightless World
description: Make a lightless world of the whole battlefield to the full reach of the tier and crush all that lives in it.
